node.title: Re: How to send email using Email::MIME & Email::Sender::Simple?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Your code looks pretty much like what the documentation of [mod://Email::Sender] says to do. I am confused however about the line my $mime_entity = $message->cast('Email::MIME');, where did you get that from, and what happens when you remove that line? Also, note how the [mod://Email::MIME] documentation starts with:

Wait! Before you read this, maybe you just need [mod://Email::Stuffer], which is a much easier-to-use tool for building simple email messages that might have attachments or both plain text and HTML.

Update: Also, have you made sure you have the newest versions of all of those modules?
